secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key — required for the AI to generate real trading signals. Get it from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey

secrets.name: BINANCE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Binance API key — optional; without it the bot uses mock market data. Get it from your Binance account API settings.

secrets.name: BINANCE_API_SECRET
secrets.description: Binance API secret — optional; paired with BINANCE_API_KEY. Get it from your Binance account API settings.
